title: HS40087: Urban Economics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: NoneCourse Contents Why and Where Do Cities Develop: Comparative
Advantage, Scale Economics, Agglomerative Economics in Production, the
Principle of Median Location, Hub Cities; The Concept of Economic Regions, the
Export Base Model, Models of Interregional Trade and Development; Trends in
Interregional Income Differentials and Cost Considerations in Interregional
Shifts; Theories of Rural-Urban Migration; Economic-Base Theory; System of
Cities and the Urban Hierarchy: Central Place Theory and Hierarchy of Central
Places, Alfred Webers Theory of Industrial Location, Theory of Agglomerations;
Input-Output Analysis; Analysis of Land as a Factor of Production and Different
Theories of Economic Rent; the Rent Offer Curve; Urban Land Use,
Suburbanization and Commuting; Urban Transportation; the Rank-Size Rule;
Optimal City Size - Pollution and Congestion; Reasons for Very Large Cities in
Developing Countries; the Relationship Between City Size and the Quality of
Life.
